key_concepts: A chemical formula shows the elements and number of atoms of each element in a compound
Subscripts in a chemical formula indicate how many atoms of each element are present
Percentage composition expresses the mass fraction of each element in a compound as a perc
Percent composition can be determined from a chemical formula or from mass data
Percent composition is calculated as the mass of an element in one mole divided by molar m
Determining percent composition requires the elements present, atomic masses, atom counts,
Percentage composition is useful in determining the empirical formula of a substance
Urea has the chemical formula H2NCONH2 and contains hydrogen, nitrogen, carbon, and oxygen
Urea is a nitrogen fertilizer that promotes green leafy growth and aids photosynthesis
Ammonium nitrate and potassium chloride are inorganic fertilizers used in farming
Molar mass is the total mass of one mole of a compound based on its chemical formula
